subject: Re: Seller experience SOW, pricing and finance clearance
messages:
From: Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@salesloft.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T16:14:00Z
Subject: Seller experience SOW - initial draft

Hi Diego,

Great talking earlier — attached is the initial SOW and a pricing workbook for a 100-seat deployment plus enablement and professional services. Highlights: 2 training days (on-site or virtual), 4-week onboarding milestone plan, and a seat-based tiered discount table.

Attachments: Salesloft-pricing-v2.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-v1.0.pdf (pdf)

Can you share any procurement constraints (PO timeline, required contract terms) and whether your security team needs additional SOC2 evidence? Happy to update the SOW based on your feedback.

Thanks,
Sarah Martin
Account Executive | Salesloft
Phone: +1 415-555-0134
[salesloft.com]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@salesloft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-13T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Seller experience SOW - initial draft

Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few asks from our side before we loop finance/procurement: 

- Can you provide an itemized breakdown that separates software seats, admin seats, and hours for professional services (by role)? We need clarity on line-item costs for our PO.
- We typically request a SOC2 attestation summary and a security questionnaire; can you point me to where we can pull those or attach the evidence?
- On pricing: confirm whether the attached workbook assumes annual prepay or month-to-month. We prefer annual commit for discounting but need the exact pricing model documented.

Marissa/Karthik: any internal gating items I should be aware of while negotiating with Salesloft?

I can take the commercial thread to Procurement once we have the updated SOW with clear commercial summary and the security docs.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[diego@redwood.com]

From: Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@salesloft.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Salesloft Commercial <commercial@salesloft.com>
Date: 2028-04-15T16:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Seller experience SOW - initial draft

Diego — attaching an updated bundle based on your notes.

Summary of changes:
- SOW updated (SOW-v1.1.pdf) to call out 100 user seats + 5 admin seats, onboarding milestones, and acceptance criteria.
- Pricing workbook (Salesloft-pricing-v2.xlsx) now includes separate line items for seats, admin seats, enablement days (4 days total), and PS hourly rates. Workbook shows both annual prepay and monthly subscription rows.
- SOC2-summary.pdf attached (summary & link to full report upon NDA).

We propose a 12-month term with an optional renewal review at month 9 to evaluate feature adoption. DocuSign-ready SOW can be provided once terms are agreed.

Link to a short recording of a similar enterprise onboarding: https://salesloft.com/demo/recording/3b2f

If you want, I can set up a 30-minute call with our Professional Services lead to walk through the onboarding scope.

Best,
Sarah Martin
Account Executive | Salesloft
Attachments: Salesloft-pricing-v2.xlsx; SOW-v1.1.pdf; SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Seller experience SOW - initial draft

Diego — quick internal note from Sales Ops/Finance perspective: 

- Procurement will require a commercial summary (line items + total ARR and one-time fees) before we can issue a PO. Please ensure the pricing workbook has a single-page commercial summary.
- For PS hours: ask Salesloft if they can reduce the default 4 days to 2 days + 4 hours of remote enablement to lower one-time fees; we can trade-off some onboarding assistance for a higher seat commit.
- Discounting: I can approve up to a 15% commercial discount without exec sign-off. Anything deeper triggers a leadership approval path. Please flag if Salesloft expects a greater concession.
- Contract term preference: 12 months with quarterly business reviews; legal will want standard SLAs and liability caps — expect redlines.

Attaching an internal business case snapshot for context. If Salesloft cannot provide clear security evidence within 3 business days, we will escalate to Security for a formal questionnaire review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: internal_bizcase.pdf

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Martin <sarah.martin@salesloft.com>, Salesloft Commercial <commercial@salesloft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T21:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Seller experience SOW - initial draft

Sarah — appreciate the updates and the quick turnaround. We're aligned to move forward pending a couple final commercial clarifications so Finance/Procurement can cut the PO: 

1) Please send a clean SOW with a one-page commercial summary that lists: unit price, quantity (100 seats + 5 admin), term (12 months), one-time professional services cost, and total first-year cost.
2) Confirm whether the pricing in Salesloft-pricing-v2.xlsx is annual prepay pricing. If there are options, include both lines clearly.
3) Provide a DocuSign link for the SOW when it's ready and a separate PDF we can attach to the PO.
4) Security: the SOC2-summary.pdf is good; please give a link or contact to request the full report under NDA.
5) Professional services: Marissa suggested we try to reduce onsite days. If Salesloft can offer 2 days + 4 hours remote for a lower one-time fee, highlight that option in the commercial summary.

If those items are included we will route to Procurement and Finance (cc'd) for PO issuance. Please include the commercial contact for invoicing.

Deal reference: DEAL-4982 — please include in the SOW header.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199
[diego@redwood.com]
